Calories in Paella valenciana (Valencian paella)

A serving of Valencian paella (307 g) has 515 kcal, 168 kcal per 100 g: 31.9 g protein, 47.5 g carbs and 20.8 g fat. Below: what a real serving weighs, where the calories come from and how it compares with similar dishes.

Updated 8 November 2026·By Fotocal, Madrid·How we calculate

Quick answer: Paella valenciana (Valencian paella) has 515 kcal per serving (307 g) and 168 kcal per 100 g. A serving gives 31.9 g protein, 47.5 g carbs and 20.8 g fat. Half a serving is about 258 kcal; a serving and a half, about 772. Figures from the Fotocal database, built from USDA and CIQUAL.

How big is a real serving?

Fotocal counts Valencian paella as 1 serving, 307 g, the way it is usually served in Spain: 515 kcal. Half of that is about 258 kcal; a serving and a half, about 772.

Where the calories come from

Of every 100 kcal in Valencian paella, about 38 come from carbs, 37 come from fat, 25 come from protein.

Protein 25%Carbs 38%Fat 37%

What is in a serving

The serving is built from these ingredients, gram by gram:

  • 160 g cooked white rice
  • 60 g roast chicken thigh
  • 40 g stewed rabbit
  • 25 g cooked green beans
  • 10 g tomato (sautéed)
  • 12 g olive oil

Frequently asked questions

How many calories are in Valencian paella?

A serving of Valencian paella (1 serving, 307 g) has 515 kcal: 31.9 g protein, 47.5 g carbs and 20.8 g fat. Per 100 g it is 168 kcal.

Where do the calories in Valencian paella come from?

Mostly from carbs: about 38 of every 100 kcal. The rest is protein 25%, fat 37%.

How many calories are in half a serving or a bigger one?

Half a serving (154 g) is about 258 kcal; a serving and a half (460 g), about 772 kcal. For any other amount, weigh it and multiply the grams by 168, then divide by 100.
